name: changelog
tagline_zh: 发版前还在手写每个包的 CHANGELOG？它用 git-cliff 按包起草，你只管筛选，RC 转正自动合并。
tagline_en: Tired of hand-writing per-package changelogs? It drafts with git-cliff, you curate, and RC-to-GA collapse is.
desc_en: Update per-package CHANGELOG.md files for a Ratel release. Drafts entries with git-cliff (scoped per package), lets you curate, then writes the CHANGELOGs. Handles both RC entries and GA-graduation collapse (merging X.Y.Z-rc.* sections into a single X.Y.Z section). Invoke before tagging a release.
why_zh: 同类工具只生成单个文件，它按包拆分并处理 RC 合并，专为 Ratel 发版设计，别处没有。
why_en: Unlike generic tools, it scopes per package and collapses RC sections into GA—built for Ratel releases.
